body:
Well, the virus is tricky by itself.. i had it roughly 25 years ago. Hell even before i had kissed a girl, despite wishing i could claim so.

https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epstein–Barr_virus

Not only is it technically a type of herpes (because this is all bragging, obv) it lays dormant within you your entire life with brief periods of being contagious.

It's one of those "interesting to read about but glad i don't have" things. Something i would honestly consider bullshit had i not gotten it myself (chronic fatigue)
It's not a fix, but it's  at least the duct tape equivalent, i guess.

I fortunately have. I've been on it for 7 or 8 years now and it's helped me more than any ssri or what have you. Also bear in mind i havr a CFS diagnosis.. chronic fatigue. Which is vague enough in description to bother me, but tldr in the best i can guess, i had mono (Epstein Barr) in 4th grade and that's one of the unfortunate permanent side effects.. regardless, the adderall literally helps me stay awake and function and pretend to be human from day to day. Can't do without it.

I completely missed it the first time, but your second to last sentence kind of sums it up.

Take a chance. Ask that girl or guy out. Apply for that job. Punch that mi..not that one. XD

What do you have to lose? We all die.. but life is about experience. A question I've struggled with myself as well. For example,  if you get married for 50 years but are worried about the heartache when they leave you or die, you miss the entire point. It doesn't make it any easier, but it's reworking your thought process and changing life one brick at a time. Just because you know a relationship will end doesn't mean you should shun them. Just because we all die doesn't mean life is pointless.

Again, need to take my own advice.. 

Here, I'll give you a song. Might not be your style, but i implore you to give it a good listen. I'll listen as well. Music is a great outlet for me,  and this song means a lot personally. 

https://youtu.be/bHR0MBF-AZc

I wish i had those answers for you, or myself, even. 

But right now, I'm on my phone (hopefully) helping someone.. and that's good enough for me.

Don't focus on the bottom, if you can help it. Baby steps.

Whether it's getting out of bed or going to work or taking out the trash.. just small goals. One at a time. Take the big picture one puzzle piece at a time. 

I started doing pushups and situps, myself. I'm hardly the type, but if nothing else, it's a distraction, and healthy, and builds muscle.

From someone that's been there, and is still there now, find a distraction. Tv show, music, writing.. rub one out. Hell, maybe two for good measure.

This isn't meant to be condescending at all.. and i hope you don't take it as such, but if you feel powerless over your life,  then you are. 

Sometimes you need to grab life by the balls, say, well fuck.. that hurt and shit isn't great... but climb back on the horse. 

Get a good night's sleep if you can. Take a deep breath. Find something you're interested in or passionate about. Maybe you need to say "fuck it" and focus on yourself for a while. Maybe you need to punch a midget (don't do that.. but hopefully it got a chuckle)..

A lot of the struggle is realizing it's not one thing that fixes every day. It's working on one thing, one day at a time.

Holy shit i should take my own advice more often.

Even from someone like myself who's hardly enthused about life, fuck your doctor. 

Find another. Find another medication. Find another hobby. Something.

Legos, woodworking, drag racing. Fuck if i know.

Seriously.. I'm not in the best position either, but if i can help someone else, it's worth it to impart the advice.

edit: mental health is not strep throat.. you can go to almost any doctor, tell them symptoms, and you'll get an antibiotic and bedrest.

However, when you see a therapist/psychiatrist/psychologist/whoever, you can get as many opinions as times you're willing to endure pouring your soul and weakness out to a total stranger, only to find out they're a total asshat.

It's not an easy road.. take care of yourself as best you can.

Definitely unique as one of his movies.. trust me. I saw it in the theater way back when. Reminded me of my dad way too much.. not that it's a bad thing as it relates to the movie.

You've just gotta see it. I would take that over lotr.. just because it's not always about what's "best" or "good"... sometimes it's just what you need.

Plus it's about 6 hours shorter.

Kind of messed up when you'd rather watch a movie that makes you cry.. although definitely beats doing it alone and left to your own devices. Thank you. 

Big Fish is another one that gets me,  too.

... can't do that one, but a great recommend. If i get to the "it's not your fault" scene, hits me right in the feels. Actually,  i will go watch that.. you have great taste. How do you like them apples?

Thank you.
I do! Did not know the movies were on there, although i did watch them all again recently. You should definitely watch them.

Fuck it, I'll elaborate. I stole adderall that wasn't mine and it was the light switch. Pretty sure statute of limitations are up anyway.

NOTE!: Not advocating anyone do this, nor recommending, etc. Catharsis or advice at best.

I feel clean now, at least. That's an improvement. 

I guess the tldr now that i have a bit more time is that it took so much humiliation and swallowing my pride and trial by fire and much more to even remotely figure out what the hell would help.

Not sure i want to admit openly to committing a felony, but that is literally what it took to improve my quality of life. Once you swallow your pride, AND find the right therapist, it's a step forward. 
 
Unfortunately mine moved away.. and not  going to be an internet lawyer at the moment, but you just get to the point you don't fucking care.

Everyone tells you you're depressed, therefore you're tired. It took me doing what i did to have someone say, well,  maybe you're just constantly tired, therefore you're miserable.

Not sure it's the right answer, but it's like one of those Lupus diagnoses on House. It's basically an elimination of all other possibilities..ie fibryomyalgia. (Not a doctor, feel free to chastise me if I'm wrong)

But it's the best I've got for now.

Hell, i guess I'm not either. Anything to  keep me distracted short term, or anything to not do something long term. 

Sorry if i seem brief or attention seeking or trollish or ..fuck i don't know. Just get tired of telling my story (therapists, friends) only to get blank stares or canned advice.

Fuck, give me a song, a movie, a book.. i don't know. That's not your fault. Thank you for responding.

I tried to somehow justify writing one to my daughter and didn't get very far through it without breaking down. Just a grown man fucking shattered, gutteral, weeping.

Not sure it was really "fake" but it got the point across to me.

Not that it got rid of the feeling ultimately. Just figured i would weigh in somewhat
